title: Treasury Department Announces New Appointments
summary: Secretary of the Treasury Scott Bessent announced senior appointments including James Bacon as Senior Advisor, Charlie Bolton as Deputy Assistant Secretary for Macroeconomics, Francis Brooke performing delegable duties of Deputy Secretary, and other personnel across Treasury divisions. The announcement focuses on biographical backgrounds and career histories of appointees.
key_points: James Bacon appointed as Senior Advisor to the Secretary; previously worked at Thiel Capital and The Heritage Foundation after serving in the first Trump administration

Charlie Bolton appointed as Deputy Assistant Secretary for Macroeconomics; former Senate staffer and Chief Economist for Senator Rob Portman (2017-2020); MIT Sloan graduate with expertise in stablecoin economics and ERISA law

Francis Brooke performing delegable duties of Deputy Secretary of the Treasury; currently Acting Under Secretary for International Affairs; previously Policy Director for House Majority Leader Steve Scalise

Eric Ettorre appointed as Deputy Assistant Secretary for Trade and Investment; former Trade Counsel for the House Ways and Means Committee Trade Subcommittee with portfolio including US-China policy and tariffs
Gene Lange performing delegable duties of Under Secretary for Terrorism and Financial Intelligence; 25+ years in investment fund industry including roles at Key Square Capital and Duquesne Capital
why_it_matters: The personnel composition at Treasury may influence future policy execution and Treasury's operational stance, particularly in areas of international trade, financial intelligence, and macroeconomic policy. However, this announcement provides biographical information rather than policy substance.
